content.json:
# Gov Policy Copilot – operations
Outcomes, latency, cost and safety. Source: Application Insights (OpenTelemetry).

content.query:
// Copilot outcomes over time: answered / escalated / not_found / out_of_scope / blocked
traces
| where timestamp > ago(7d) and message == "copilot_request"
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| render columnchart kind=stacked
content.title: Outcomes over time

content.query:
// End-to-end copilot latency percentiles per hour, by prompt version
traces
| where timestamp > ago(7d) and message == "copilot_request"
| extend latency_s = todouble(customDimensions.latency_ms) / 1000, prompt_version = tostring(customDimensions.prompt_version)
| summarize p50 = percentile(latency_s, 50), p95 = percentile(latency_s, 95), n = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), prompt_version
| render timechart
content.title: Latency p50 / p95 (s)

content.query:
// LLM cost and tokens per day (list prices configured in Settings.price_*)
traces
| where timestamp > ago(30d) and message == "copilot_request"
| summarize
    queries = count(),
    cost_usd = round(sum(todouble(customDimensions.cost_usd)), 4),
    prompt_tokens = sum(toint(customDimensions.prompt_tokens)),
    completion_tokens = sum(toint(customDimensions.completion_tokens))
    by day = bin(timestamp, 1d), model = tostring(customDimensions.model)
| extend cost_per_query = round(cost_usd / queries, 5)
| order by day desc
content.title: Cost per day

content.query:
// Daily escalation (human review) rate and mean groundedness
traces
| where timestamp > ago(30d) and message == "copilot_request"
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome), g = todouble(customDimensions.groundedness)
| summarize total = count(), escalated = countif(outcome == "escalated"), mean_groundedness = avgif(g, isnotnull(g)) by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| extend escalation_rate = round(100.0 * escalated / total, 2)
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Escalation rate

content.query:
// Safety blocks. Reason is recorded on the request span (copilot.blocked_reason).
dependencies
| union requests
| where timestamp > ago(30d) and isnotempty(customDimensions["copilot.blocked_reason"])
| summarize blocked = count() by reason = tostring(customDimensions["copilot.blocked_reason"])
| order by blocked desc
content.title: Safety blocks by reason

content.query:
// Outbound calls to Azure OpenAI / AI Search / Content Safety (dependency telemetry)
dependencies
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where target has_any ("openai.azure.com", "search.windows.net", "cognitiveservices.azure.com")
| summarize calls = count(), failures = countif(success == false), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by target, name
| order by calls desc
content.title: Azure AI dependencies
